shortDescription: Pertamina Hulu Energi, the upstream unit of Indonesia's state energy firm Pertamina [RIC:RIC:PERTM.UL], has signed sales and purchase agreement with Italy's Eni MIL:ENI to acquire participating interests in three oil and gas blocks, Pertamina said on Monday.
